The ED visit is the most recent Encounter with class code EMER, status finished and a period start on or before the as-of date. The dates are period start dates (YYYY-MM-DD); days_to_followup (integer) is the number of days between them; within_30_days (boolean) is days_to_followup <= 30. measurements has one entry for every Observation whose encounter references the follow-up Encounter and has a valueQuantity, and one for every component with a valueQuantity of such an Observation (a blood pressure panel gives systolic and diastolic), sorted by code, each with exactly these keys: code (string: the first code.coding code of the Observation or component), date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (both Encounters, the DocumentReference whose context references the ED Encounter, and each listed Observation), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.
